description_en: 📍 LAKE VIEW – On the edge of Kosovareve Street Apartment 2+1+2 + Veranda for sale ✨ Main details: • 🏢 Floor: 5 • 📐 Living area: 130 m² • 🌿 Veranda: 20 m² • 🚗 Parking post: floor -3, 43 m² • 🆕 Newly completed building • 🌬️ Ventilation system, suspended ceilings, modern installations • 💰 Price: 486,000 € ⸻ ⭐ Apartment investments and improvements 1️⃣ Heating/cooling system • Multi-split (one motor – several indoor units) • Ceiling cassette (hidden AC) • Suspended ceiling (gypsum) to hide pipes and lights 💡 Major investment that increases value and comfort. ⸻ 2️⃣ Premium lighting • LED lights inserted in the ceiling • Ambient lighting in the corridor • LED spots • Hidden lighting (LED strips) 💡 Good lighting makes the space look more modern, warmer and more luxurious. ⸻ 3️⃣ Doors & security • Quality interior doors • High class security blind door 💡 Increases insulation, security and adds elegance to the entrance. ⸻ 🏞️ Why is this apartment worth it? ✓ Elite location, very close to Artificial Lake ✓ New building with contemporary standards ✓ Spacious veranda + large parking ✓ Perfect for living or investment with high rental potential ⸻ 📞 For more information or to visit the property, contact!
